name: Green Scarf
description: A hold item that raises Smart in Contests.

gifts.note: After your first Contest. The Fan Club Chairman only rates Pokémon once you have entered a Pokémon Contest in Lilycove City. Then talk to him with a lead Pokémon whose Cool, Beauty, Cute, Smart or Tough condition is 200 or more (raise it with Pokéblocks). He gives the matching scarf: Red for Cool, Blue for Beauty, Pink for Cute, Green for Smart, Yellow for Tough. One scarf per conversation, each only once.
